  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that just as the elevation of souls reveals their root in Atzmus, so too the elevation of mitzvos draws from Atzmus, culminating in the second level of the Menorah's face, "upon My face," where the soul's root in Atzmus is revealed and drawn into the mitzvos, as per the teaching that when Israel fulfills mitzvos, they cause the Holy One to perform them.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, just as according to the interpretation that "When you raise up the lamps" refers to the souls,</t>
    <t s="2">the main aspect of their elevation is the revelation of their root as they are rooted in the Awtsmoos,</t>
    <t s="3">so too is it according to the interpretation that "When you raise up the lamps" refers to the mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="4">that their elevation is that [the Awtsmoos] is drawn into them.</t>
    <t s="5">For through the fact that Yisrael fulfill the mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="6">[and] the root of the souls of Yisrael is in the Awtsmoos,</t>
    <t s="7">they draw this also into the mitzvos.</t>
    <t s="8">For this that was stated above, that through fulfillment of mitzvos one comes to love and fear [of G-d],</t>
    <t s="9">means that the mitzvos are above the person who fulfills them and they affect him so that he comes to love and fear [of G-d],</t>
    <t s="10">a love and fear that is above reason and intellect, which he is incapable of attaining through [his own] service</t>
    <t s="11">(contemplation)</t>
    <t s="12">and are drawn from above through the mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="13">this is at the beginning of the service.</t>
    <t s="14">But after he attains these loves and fears,</t>
    <t s="15">the first level of the "face"</t>
    <t s="16">(inwardness)</t>
    <t s="17">of the Menorah,</t>
    <t s="18">there is revealed in him the root of the soul as it is rooted in the Awtsmoos,</t>
    <t s="19">the second level of the "face" of the Menorah,</t>
    <t s="20">the aspect of "upon My face,"</t>
    <t s="21">the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="22">and this matter he also draws into the mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="23">as per the statement of our sages, of blessed memory,</t>
    <t s="24">on the verse,</t>
    <t s="25">"He declares His words to Yaakov, His statutes and judgments to Yisrael,"</t>
    <t s="26">"What He does, He tells Yisrael to do,"</t>
    <t s="27">and the explanation of this is known,</t>
    <t s="28">that through Yisrael doing and fulfilling the mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="29">through this they cause that the Holy One, blessed be He, performs these mitzvos.</t>
    <t s="30">[And in the manner known</t>
    <t s="31">regarding the Torah,</t>
    <t s="32">that after Yisrael become bound to the Torah and through it to the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="33">the root of Yisrael, which is above the root of the Torah, is revealed,</t>
    <t s="34">and after the root of Yisrael is revealed in His very Essence,</t>
    <t s="35">they draw this also into the Torah,</t>
    <t s="36">in the manner that Dovid would connect the supernal Torah with the Holy One, blessed be He.]</t>
    <t s="37">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="38">that this is what the Baal HaMaor said</t>
    <t s="39">(brought above)</t>
    <t s="40">that the explanation of "When you raise up the lamps" is "with the lamps,"</t>
    <t s="41">"When you raise up yourself with the mitzvos,"</t>
    <t s="42">that the intention in this is,</t>
    <t s="43">that a person elevates the mitzvos to the place that he himself ascends to,</t>
    <t s="44">the second level of the "face" of the Menorah,</t>
    <t s="45">the aspect of "upon My face."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that just as the verse states the seven lamps shall give light toward the face of the Menorah, so too in the inner dimension, the service of Yisrael adds light to the luminaries, elevating the world to become a dwelling place for His very Essence, even beyond its original state of creation.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And it can be added,</t>
    <t s="2">that just as according to the simple meaning of the verse,</t>
    <t s="3">"Toward the face of the Menorah" the seven lamps shall give light,</t>
    <t s="4">so too is it in the inner dimension of the matters,</t>
    <t s="5">that "toward the face of the Menorah," which refers to the aspect of "upon My face,"</t>
    <t s="6">there comes an additional consequence beyond "When you raise up the lamps," which refers to the souls,</t>
    <t s="7">also that "the seven lamps shall give light."</t>
    <t s="8">For this, that through the service of Yisrael light is added to the luminaries</t>
    <t s="9">(in the manner that Sarah added to the luminaries),</t>
    <t s="10">is in addition to the filling of the deficiency that was caused by the diminution of the moon,</t>
    <t s="11">there is also made in them an additional elevation relative to their level as they were [originally] the two great luminaries.</t>
    <t s="12">For although the world was created in its fullness,</t>
    <t s="13">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="14">through the service of man, an elevation is made in the world, even higher than it was at the beginning of its creation</t>
    <t s="15">[all the more so from this, that through service an elevation is made in the mitzvos and even in the souls],</t>
    <t s="16">that the world becomes a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="17">for His very Essence.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section concludes that through the service of "When you raise up the lamps," the seven lamps will illuminate all the aforementioned matters, hastening the future redemption when night will shine like day, and even in the final days of exile, each Jew will have light in their dwelling, hastening the complete redemption through Moshiach.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And through the service of "When you raise up the lamps... the seven lamps shall give light" in all the matters mentioned above,</t>
    <t s="2">they bring near and hasten the promise</t>
    <t s="3">that "night will shine like day,"</t>
    <t s="4">in the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach.</t>
    <t s="5">And even before this,</t>
    <t s="6">in the final days of the darkness of exile,</t>
    <t s="7">"for all the children of Yisrael there will be light in their dwellings,"</t>
    <t s="8">through each one adding light and vitality in his service,</t>
    <t s="9">and this will hasten even more the fulfillment of the promise that "night will shine like day,"</t>
    <t s="10">with the coming of our righteous Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="11">may he come and redeem us and lead us upright to our land,</t>
    <t s="12">for then there will be the elevation</t>
    <t s="13">("When you raise up")</t>
    <t s="14">in all the matters to the ultimate perfection,</t>
    <t s="15">in inwardness and externality together.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that just as the elevation of souls reveals their root in Atzmus, so too the elevation of mitzvos draws from Atzmus, culminating in the second level of the Menorah's face, "upon My face," where the soul's root in Atzmus is revealed and drawn into the mitzvos, as per the teaching that when Israel fulfills mitzvos, they cause the Holy One to perform them.

translations.translation: Now, just as according to the interpretation that "When you raise up the lamps" refers to the souls,
the main aspect of their elevation is the revelation of their root as they are rooted in the Awtsmoos,
so too is it according to the interpretation that "When you raise up the lamps" refers to the mitzvos,
that their elevation is that [the Awtsmoos] is drawn into them.
For through the fact that Yisrael fulfill the mitzvos,
[and] the root of the souls of Yisrael is in the Awtsmoos,
they draw this also into the mitzvos.
For this that was stated above, that through fulfillment of mitzvos one comes to love and fear [of G-d],
means that the mitzvos are above the person who fulfills them and they affect him so that he comes to love and fear [of G-d],
a love and fear that is above reason and intellect, which he is incapable of attaining through [his own] service
(contemplation)
and are drawn from above through the mitzvos,
this is at the beginning of the service.
But after he attains these loves and fears,
the first level of the "face"
(inwardness)
of the Menorah,
there is revealed in him the root of the soul as it is rooted in the Awtsmoos,
the second level of the "face" of the Menorah,
the aspect of "upon My face,"
the Holy One, blessed be He,
and this matter he also draws into the mitzvos,
as per the statement of our sages, of blessed memory,
on the verse,
"He declares His words to Yaakov, His statutes and judgments to Yisrael,"
"What He does, He tells Yisrael to do,"
and the explanation of this is known,
that through Yisrael doing and fulfilling the mitzvos,
through this they cause that the Holy One, blessed be He, performs these mitzvos.
[And in the manner known
regarding the Torah,
that after Yisrael become bound to the Torah and through it to the Holy One, blessed be He,
the root of Yisrael, which is above the root of the Torah, is revealed,
and after the root of Yisrael is revealed in His very Essence,
they draw this also into the Torah,
in the manner that Dovid would connect the supernal Torah with the Holy One, blessed be He.]
And it can be said,
that this is what the Baal HaMaor said
(brought above)
that the explanation of "When you raise up the lamps" is "with the lamps,"
"When you raise up yourself with the mitzvos,"
that the intention in this is,
that a person elevates the mitzvos to the place that he himself ascends to,
the second level of the "face" of the Menorah,
the aspect of "upon My face."

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that just as the verse states the seven lamps shall give light toward the face of the Menorah, so too in the inner dimension, the service of Yisrael adds light to the luminaries, elevating the world to become a dwelling place for His very Essence, even beyond its original state of creation.

translations.translation: And it can be added,
that just as according to the simple meaning of the verse,
"Toward the face of the Menorah" the seven lamps shall give light,
so too is it in the inner dimension of the matters,
that "toward the face of the Menorah," which refers to the aspect of "upon My face,"
there comes an additional consequence beyond "When you raise up the lamps," which refers to the souls,
also that "the seven lamps shall give light."
For this, that through the service of Yisrael light is added to the luminaries
(in the manner that Sarah added to the luminaries),
is in addition to the filling of the deficiency that was caused by the diminution of the moon,
there is also made in them an additional elevation relative to their level as they were [originally] the two great luminaries.
For although the world was created in its fullness,
nevertheless,
through the service of man, an elevation is made in the world, even higher than it was at the beginning of its creation
[all the more so from this, that through service an elevation is made in the mitzvos and even in the souls],
that the world becomes a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He,
for His very Essence.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section concludes that through the service of "When you raise up the lamps," the seven lamps will illuminate all the aforementioned matters, hastening the future redemption when night will shine like day, and even in the final days of exile, each Jew will have light in their dwelling, hastening the complete redemption through Moshiach.

translations.translation: And through the service of "When you raise up the lamps... the seven lamps shall give light" in all the matters mentioned above,
they bring near and hasten the promise
that "night will shine like day,"
in the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach.
And even before this,
in the final days of the darkness of exile,
"for all the children of Yisrael there will be light in their dwellings,"
through each one adding light and vitality in his service,
and this will hasten even more the fulfillment of the promise that "night will shine like day,"
with the coming of our righteous Moshiach,
may he come and redeem us and lead us upright to our land,
for then there will be the elevation
("When you raise up")
in all the matters to the ultimate perfection,
in inwardness and externality together.
